item.title: Greek "FBI" Dismantles 180 Crime Rings in 16 Months
item.description: Greece’s so-called “Greek FBI” — the Directorate for Combating Organised Crime (DAOE) within the Hellenic Police — dismantled more than 180 organised crime networks in its first 16 months of operation, according to police figures. item.description: A wall collapsed on Friday afternoon, 13 February 2026, in the “Kremala” neighbourhood of Messini, alarming local residents.
